name: Krishi Shah
title: Applied Machine Learning
shortBio: Final-year Honours Computer Science student at York University building machine learning and generative AI systems end to end. One year of production engineering with the Ontario Government, and a research term on AI-generated image detection.
longBio: I build applied machine learning and generative AI systems from data validation through training, calibration, explainability, and deployment. That includes a year of production software engineering with the Ontario Government (Co-op of the Year nominee) and a research term on detecting AI-generated images.
